summary: Explains that notified handlers run automatically after `pre_tasks`, `roles`/`tasks`, and `post_tasks`, so each runs once. `meta: flush_handlers` runs notified handlers immediately, and handlers can be notified and run again afterward.
questions: How do I make a handler run in the middle of a play instead of at the end?
When exactly do handlers run during a play?
Can a handler run more than once in a play?

answer_card.title: Control when handlers run
answer_card.answer_md:
By default notified handlers run after each section, in order: `pre_tasks`, `roles`/`tasks`, then `post_tasks`. Each runs once however many tasks notified it.

To run them earlier, flush:
```yaml
tasks:
  - ansible.builtin.shell: ...
  - name: Flush handlers
    meta: flush_handlers
  - ansible.builtin.shell: ...
```
`meta: flush_handlers` runs any handlers notified so far. After handlers run (automatically or via flush), they can be notified and run again later in the play.
